text:
Google built an AI that predicts the future.

it's called TimesFM, Google Research's time-series forecasting model.
feed it your own history, sales, traffic, demand, and it predicts what comes next.

no fine-tuning. it works zero-shot, straight out of the box.

the numbers behind https://t.co/NwcQh7yJxK

it's open source, 28K stars on GitHub:
https://t.co/fQwRxP4Har

forecasting used to mean building a model per dataset. ARIMA, Prophet, a custom LSTM, weeks of tuning each time.
TimesFM skips all of it. 1 model, any dataset, an instant forecast.

a forecast is only half the job though. a raw number does nothing until you can get an AI to turn it into a decision, and that comes down to how you prompt it.

learn to prompt AI properly, free guide here:

https://t.co/0Z9r9x1nFU

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you'd rather act on the forecast than just watch it happen.

Stripe's Will Gaybrick: "Build everything"

Against an industry that sees agents as a way to cut costs, Stripe is using them to build more: agents wrote 30% of code in a week, global tax filing shipped in 1/3 the time the US version took, and after AI made sellers 20% more https://t.co/l1YddyQBGX
